title: LIGO direct gravitational-wave detection to a new observational channel
sourceNativeSummary: Decades of interferometer, isolation, laser, control, waveform-model and distributed-detector development culminated in the September 2015 GW150914 observation, the first direct gravitational-wave detection.
rivalOrBoundary: The primary capability was not only confirmation of a theory but a new instrumented observational channel that made previously inaccessible astrophysical events measurable.
